B5.Field.name: Name
B5.Hint.abilityBreakdown: Racial and level modifiers are applied automatically from the race and class items.
B5.Hint.flatFooted: Keeps the class Defence bonus; loses the Dex bonus and all dodge bonuses.
B5.Hint.noArmourClass: This system has no Armour Class — armour grants DR, never a bonus to DV.
B5.Hint.drPipeline: Damage taken = damage − max(0, DR − weapon AP).
B5.Hint.subtypedSkills: Knowledge, Operations, Profession and Technical are added as items, one per subtype.
B5.Hint.influenceCheck: Influence checks roll 2d6 + score — never d20.
B5.Hint.socialBonus: Best Influence bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidate
B5.Hint.pRatingFixed: The P-Rating is set at character creation and never changes.
B5.Hint.mentalEffort: Using an ability above your P-Rating costs 1d4 nonlethal damage per point, up to 6 dice.
B5.Hint.donTime: Donning takes ACP + 1 minutes, halved on a DC 15 Dexterity check.
B5.Hint.ammoLegality: Ammunition is often illegal even when the weapon itself is only restricted.
B5.Hint.totalOffence: Total Offence = highest Offence + half of every other hit.
B5.Hint.craftDamage: Each point of damage destroys one structural space; the craft explodes at 0 Armour.
B5.Hint.dropActorOnStation: Drag a character or NPC onto a station to assign it. The posting is mirrored on their sheet.
B5.Tooltip.nonlethal: Tracked separately; it is never subtracted from hit points.
B5.Tooltip.dv: 10 + class Defence bonus + Dex mod + size mod
B5.Tooltip.dr: Damage Reduction from armour, race and other sources
B5.Tooltip.initiative: Initiative is a plain Dexterity check
B5.Tooltip.acp: Armour check penalty applies to this skill
B5.Tooltip.addSubtypedSkill: Add a Knowledge / Operations / Profession / Technical skill
B5.Tooltip.burned: Points permanently burned to boost failed checks
B5.Tooltip.usesThisWeek: Each attempt after the first is at −4 for a week
B5.Tooltip.telepathySaveDC: 5 + P-Rating + telepath class levels + Cha mod
B5.Tooltip.mentalEffort: Nonlethal damage paid to use an ability above your P-Rating
B5.Tooltip.power: Required P-Rating to use this ability for free
B5.Tooltip.ap: Armour piercing: ignores this much DR
B5.Tooltip.armourDr: Armour grants DR only — never a bonus to Defence Value
B5.Tooltip.ammoCapacity: Capacity is a property of the weapon, not of the clip
B5.Tooltip.ammoId: Must match the weapon's Ammo ID
B5.Tooltip.firstLevel: The class taken at 1st level supplies the Initial HP and the Con modifier
B5.Tooltip.initialHp: Applied once, at 1st level, together with the Con modifier
B5.Tooltip.canBeTelepath: Narn can never have a P-Rating
B5.Tooltip.craftArmour: A craft explodes when Armour reaches 0
B5.Tooltip.offence: Weapon Offence value used to build the barrage
B5.Tooltip.absorbsDamage: A destroyed feature absorbs 1d4 damage on a location roll of 12
B5.Empty.classes: No class yet — add one to derive BAB, saves and Defence.
B5.Warning.multiclassPenalty: Class levels differ by more than one — this character takes a −20% XP penalty.
B5.Tooltip.raceFeatBonus: Bonuses applied automatically by the race and by feats
B5.Tooltip.autoClassSkill: Granted by a class or by the race — cannot be unticked
B5.Hint.autoApplied: Ability modifiers, class skills and the numeric effects of feats are applied automatically from the race, class and feat items.
B5.Tooltip.unmetFeats: Feats whose prerequisites are not met
B5.Hint.prerequisites: Prerequisites are checked automatically. Narrative gates — a great injustice suffered, the GM's permission — are only reported, never enforced, and nothing is blocked.
B5.Tooltip.skillBudget: Spent / budget. The budget is (class points + Int mod) ×4 at 1st level, then per level, plus racial bonuses.
B5.Tooltip.skillPointsOverride: Replaces the calculated budget — use it when the Intelligence modifier changed mid-career
B5.Tooltip.overMaxRanks: Above the maximum ranks for this character level
B5.Hint.crossClassCost: A class rank costs 1 point, a cross-class rank costs 2.
B5.Warning.dropOnStation: Drop the character onto a station.
B5.Warning.craftAsCrew: A craft cannot serve as crew.
B5.Tooltip.roleMayAttack: This role may make attack rolls
B5.Tooltip.roleSkillMissing: The character has no ranks in this skill — Operations and Technical are trained only
B5.Tooltip.crewTraining: Rolls no PC covers are made by the crew with its Training bonus
B5.Hint.stationRules: One role per character per turn; that character handles every order using the role's skill. Only one character per skill.
B5.Order.fireAtWill.name: All Hands… Fire At Will!
B5.Order.fireAtWill.effect: Fire whichever in-arc, in-range weapons you wish at one designated target; attack rolls as normal.
B5.Order.fireAtWill.failure: The attacks are still made, all at −4.
B5.Order.broadsides.name: Broadsides!
B5.Order.broadsides.effect: Needs two or more targets. Port and Starboard batteries fire at separate targets; a target hit by one side may not be fired on by the other.
B5.Order.broadsides.failure: The attacks are still made, all at −4.
B5.Order.concentrateFire.name: Concentrate All Fire!
B5.Order.concentrateFire.effect: All chosen weapons fire at one target at +2 to attack rolls; the craft loses its Handling bonus to DV until its next offensive order.
B5.Order.concentrateFire.failure: The attacks are made at −4 instead of +2.
B5.Order.fighterScreen.name: Fighter Screen!
B5.Order.fighterScreen.effect: Designated close-range weapons attack any solo craft that enters close range or acts within it, before it completes its order.
B5.Order.fighterScreen.failure: The screen is set up, but its attacks are at −4 (−6 as a response).
B5.Order.fireMainGun.name: Fire Main Gun!
B5.Order.fireMainGun.effect: Victory-class only: fires the Lightning Cannon at one target in arc. Must be the turn's first and only order; the craft loses its Handling bonus to DV until its next order.
B5.Order.fireMainGun.failure: The attack is still made at −4.
B5.Order.spray.name: Spray!
B5.Order.spray.effect: Weapons are divided among as many targets as the commander wishes; each weapon system fires at only one target.
B5.Order.spray.failure: The attacks are still made, all at −4.
B5.Order.targetBridge.name: Target Their Bridge!
B5.Order.targetBridge.effect: The target's base DV drops to that of a craft four superscale sizes smaller; all damage goes to control spaces. Targets of Small superscale size or smaller cannot be picked.
B5.Order.targetBridge.failure: The attacks are made against the raised DV and do not strike control spaces.
B5.Order.targetEngines.name: Target Their Engines!
B5.Order.targetEngines.effect: The target's base DV drops to that of a craft three superscale sizes smaller; all damage goes to engine spaces, with the excess taken off Armour.
B5.Order.targetEngines.failure: The attacks are made against the raised DV and do not strike the engines.
B5.Order.targetCargo.name: Target Their Cargo Pods!
B5.Order.targetCargo.effect: As Target Their Engines!, but the damage goes to cargo spaces; the excess rolls on Random Craft Damage.
B5.Order.targetCargo.failure: The attacks are made against the raised DV and do not strike the holds.
B5.Order.targetLaunchBays.name: Target Their Launch Bays!
B5.Order.targetLaunchBays.effect: As Target Their Engines!, but the damage goes to hangar spaces; the excess rolls on Random Craft Damage.
B5.Order.targetLaunchBays.failure: The attacks are made against the raised DV and do not strike the hangars.
B5.Order.targetWeapons.name: Target Their Weapons!
B5.Order.targetWeapons.effect: As Target Their Engines!, but the damage goes to the weapon spaces of one arc of your choice; the excess rolls on Random Craft Damage.
B5.Order.targetWeapons.failure: The attacks are made against the raised DV and do not strike the weapons.
B5.Order.blastOnLaunch.name: Blast Them As They Launch!
B5.Order.blastOnLaunch.effect: Response to Launch Fighters!: every launched craft suffers one attack from a weapon system in arc, and gets no Handling bonus to DV.
B5.Order.blastOnLaunch.failure: The attacks are still made, all at −4.
B5.Order.opportunityFire.name: Opportunity Fire!
B5.Order.opportunityFire.effect: Fire whichever weapons are in arc and range at the craft whose order you interrupted.
B5.Order.opportunityFire.failure: The attacks are still made, all at −4.
B5.Order.braceForImpact.name: Brace For Impact
B5.Order.braceForImpact.effect: +2 to Technical checks resisting impairment, and every structural area damaged this round loses one space fewer.
B5.Order.defensivePosition.name: Defensive Position
B5.Order.defensivePosition.effect: Choose: add 1 to any Random Craft Damage roll you suffer (decided after the dice), or force a random system roll against a system-targeting order.
B5.Order.defensivePosition.failure: No benefit; as a response, also make a Stress check.
B5.Order.extremeMeasures.name: Extreme Measures!
B5.Order.extremeMeasures.effect: +1 dodge bonus to DV per point above 20, capped by Handling; an equal penalty applies to the craft's attack rolls. Lasts the round.
B5.Order.extremeMeasures.failure: No benefit; Stress check at −3 (−6 as a response).
B5.Order.fireInterceptors.name: Fire Interceptors!
B5.Order.fireInterceptors.effect: Fired after Total Offence is calculated: success cuts the barrage by the intercepting system's Intercept value. Beam weapons ignore interceptors.
B5.Order.fireInterceptors.failure: The interceptors are designated, but every check from this order is at −4 (−6 as a response).
B5.Order.shakeTheLock.name: Shake The Lock!
B5.Order.shakeTheLock.effect: Every enemy holding a lock rolls Sensors; each roll your check beats loses that lock.
B5.Order.pivot.name: Pivot!
B5.Order.pivot.effect: Needs Pivotal Thrusters. Automatically strips every enemy solo craft of its Targeting Run! bonuses against you.
B5.Order.pivot.failure: Still targeted; Stress check at −2 (−4 as a response).
B5.Order.returnToBase.name: Return To Base
B5.Order.returnToBase.effect: Solo craft within close range of a hangar that can house it docks safely and leaves the combat.
B5.Order.returnToBase.failure: The craft docks clumsily — make a Stress check.
B5.Order.skindancing.name: Skindancing!
B5.Order.skindancing.effect: Hug a craft at least two superscale sizes larger at close range: it cannot target you, and attacks that miss you have a 50% chance of hitting it. No other orders this round.
B5.Order.afterburners.name: Afterburners To Full!
B5.Order.afterburners.effect: Needs Afterburners. Moves two range bands instead of one, as Close For Battle or Pull Back.
B5.Order.afterburners.failure: The craft moves only one band, loses Afterburners as a quality, and makes a Stress check at −2.
B5.Order.angleForEffect.name: Angle For Maximum Effect
B5.Order.angleForEffect.effect: For the rest of the round any "any one arc" order may combine weapons from two arcs — except Fore & Aft or Port & Starboard.
B5.Order.attainOrbit.name: Attain Orbit
B5.Order.attainOrbit.effect: Moves the craft from atmosphere to space and out of atmospheric combat entirely.
B5.Order.attainOrbit.failure: The craft reaches orbit but makes a Stress check at −6.
B5.Order.closeForBattle.name: Close For Battle
B5.Order.closeForBattle.effect: Moves one range band toward the centre. Not available in the close band, nor to the craft that is the centre.
B5.Order.closeForBattle.failure: The craft still moves, but loses its Handling bonus to DV and takes −2 to attack rolls for the round.
B5.Order.escortDefence.name: Escort Defence!
B5.Order.escortDefence.effect: Attacks aimed at one allied craft in your fleet have a percentage chance of hitting you instead, by relative size. Lasts the round.
B5.Order.systemsBackOnline.name: Get Those Systems Back Online
B5.Order.systemsBackOnline.effect: Restores one space to an area reduced to 0 (or a lost feature); the area is then impaired. Needs at least one control space.
B5.Order.grapple.name: Grapple
B5.Order.grapple.effect: Needs the Grapple feature; the target must be drifting or stationary at close range. Equal or smaller targets then move with you.
B5.Order.grapple.failure: The target is not grabbed; Stress check — and if that also fails, Grapple is lost as a trait.
B5.Order.hesInYourSix.name: He's In Your Six!
B5.Order.hesInYourSix.effect: Opposed Pilot check: winning strips the enemy solo craft of its targeting bonuses against you.
B5.Order.holdHerTogether.name: Hold Her Together
B5.Order.holdHerTogether.effect: Repairs an area damaged but not reduced to 0: restore one space or clear its impairment. Needs at least one control space; Self-Repairing craft restore two.
B5.Order.holdHerTogether.failure: No benefit, and a 25% chance the materials for that area are exhausted until resupply.
B5.Order.hover.name: Hover
B5.Order.hover.effect: The craft hovers about ten feet up: it leaves atmospheric combat and counts as a surface vehicle. Without the Hover feature this must succeed as the first order of every turn.
B5.Order.hover.failure: The craft crashes — roll on Crash Damage.
B5.Order.joinBattleGroup.name: Join Battle Group
B5.Order.joinBattleGroup.effect: The surface counterpart of Join Wing for solo vehicles within close range.
B5.Order.joinBattleGroup.failure: The vehicle fails to join; nothing else happens.
B5.Order.joinFleet.name: Join Fleet
B5.Order.joinFleet.effect: The craft matches a nominated flagship's course and joins its fleet; it must be within close range.
B5.Order.joinFleet.failure: The craft joins but loses its Handling bonus to DV and takes −2 to attack rolls for the round.
B5.Order.joinWing.name: Join Wing
B5.Order.joinWing.effect: Solo craft within close range of the wing joins it; joining a single other craft makes that one wing commander.
B5.Order.joinWing.failure: The craft fails to join; nothing else happens.
B5.Order.land.name: Land
B5.Order.land.effect: The craft lands where the environment allows and leaves atmospheric combat entirely; landed craft take no part in surface combat.
B5.Order.land.failure: The craft crashes — roll on Crash Damage.
B5.Order.launchFighters.name: Launch Fighters!
B5.Order.launchFighters.effect: Launches carried solo craft up to the Craft (X) rating into the same range band; they roll Knowledge (tactics) for initiative but act from the next round.
B5.Order.launchFighters.failure: Only half the intended number of craft launch.
B5.Order.lockWeapons.name: Lock Weapons
B5.Order.lockWeapons.effect: Sensor roll against the target's Stealth: on success every attack against it gains the targeting computer bonus. Simultaneous locks are capped by that bonus.
B5.Order.lockWeapons.failure: The lock fails; nothing else happens.
B5.Order.openJumpPoint.name: Open Jump Point!
B5.Order.openJumpPoint.effect: Needs a Jump Point feature or a jump gate at close range. The vortex stays open until the end of the following round; craft in the band may Pull Back through it.
B5.Order.openJumpPoint.failure: The jump point does not form. In atmosphere the vortex detonates at Total Offence d%+100, catching the creating craft.
B5.Order.pullBack.name: Pull Back
B5.Order.pullBack.effect: Moves one range band away from the centre. Executed from the sensor band, the craft leaves the battle.
B5.Order.pullBack.failure: The craft still moves, but loses its Handling bonus to DV and takes −2 to attack rolls for the round.
B5.Order.ramThem.name: Ram Them!
B5.Order.ramThem.effect: At close range: steel the crew (Training or the pilot's Will save, DC 15 — a solo pilot needs Will DC 10), then an opposed piloting check with size modifiers. Damage by the rammer's size; Fore weapons add their Offence. The rammer destroys itself.
B5.Order.ramThem.failure: If the crew falters the ram is not attempted. If the target matches or beats your check it evades, and you lose your Handling bonus to DV and take −2 to attack rolls.
B5.Order.reEntry.name: Re-Entry
B5.Order.reEntry.effect: Moves the craft from space into atmosphere; only when the centre of the battle is a planet or moon.
B5.Order.reEntry.failure: The craft skips off the atmosphere and does not enter; Stress check at −4.
B5.Order.routeControl.name: Route Control Through This Panel
B5.Order.routeControl.effect: Issuable only when every control space is destroyed: restores one control space, impaired. Prerequisite for repairs on a craft with no control left.
B5.Order.runSilent.name: Run Silent, Run Dark
B5.Order.runSilent.effect: +1 Stealth per point above 15, and the craft avoids the usual −5 Stealth for executing an order. Lasts the round.
B5.Order.seizeInitiative.name: Seize The Initiative!
B5.Order.seizeInitiative.effect: The commander's Knowledge (tactics) result becomes the craft's initiative count from the following round.
B5.Order.shadowJump.name: Shadow Jump
B5.Order.shadowJump.effect: Needs the Shadow Jump feature. Moves the craft into or out of hyperspace with no visible vortex.
B5.Order.shadowJump.failure: The craft fails to phase; nothing else happens.
B5.Order.takeOff.name: Take Off!
B5.Order.takeOff.effect: Air and spacecraft only: moves from the surface or a hover into atmosphere, leaving surface combat entirely.
B5.Order.takeOff.failure: The craft crashes — roll on Crash Damage.
B5.Order.targetingRun.name: Targeting Run!
B5.Order.targetingRun.effect: Solo craft against a target at close range: +2 to all attack rolls against it this round and +4 to any Lock Weapons attempt on it. Against a solo target it holds until they shake it off.
B5.Order.dcOverrideHint: leave empty to record the roll only
B5.Order.dcSpecialHint: No DC given — compare this result against the opposing roll or the target's Stealth.
B5.Warning.orderOncePerRound: {order} may only be issued once per round.
B5.Tooltip.resetOrders: New turn: reset the order allowance and the Stealth penalty
B5.Tooltip.effectiveStealth: Stealth after the −5 each order executed this round costs
B5.Hint.orders: The engine rolls the order, tracks the allowance and moves the range band. Which weapons fire, and how a lock or a ram plays out, stays with the table.
B5.Barrage.dvOverrideHint: leave empty to use the target's DV
B5.Barrage.controlPenalty: Control damage: {value} to every attack roll.
B5.Barrage.arrayNote: an Array cannot use the lock
B5.Barrage.electroPulseNote: Electro-Pulse: no damage, but the target loses a control space unless it makes an Operations (systems) check at DC 20.
B5.Barrage.outOfRange: out of range at this band
B5.Barrage.noTargetHint: No target chosen — nothing was applied.
B5.Barrage.noTargetResult: Barrage rolled: {damage} damage, applied to nobody.
B5.Damage.title: Craft damage
B5.Damage.cascadeExhausted: Nothing left to hit — taken off Armour
B5.Damage.engineOverflow: Engine bay already gone — taken off Armour
B5.Damage.repairConfirm: Restore every structural space, weapon mount and feature of {name}, and clear all impairments?
B5.Status.drifting: Drifting — only Brace For Impact, Get Those Systems Back Online, Hold Her Together and Route Control Through This Panel may be issued.
B5.Status.controlDestroyed: Control destroyed — −6 Sensors, −4 to every attack roll and skill check.
B5.Status.controlImpaired: Control impaired — −2 Handling, −4 Sensors, −2 to every attack roll and skill check.
B5.Status.crewLosses: Crew losses — Training and BAB reduced
B5.Tooltip.weaponImpaired: Impaired weapon system: −2 to attack rolls and half Offence
B5.Tooltip.repairSpaces: Full repair: every space, mount and feature restored
B5.Warning.noCraftWeapons: This craft has no weapons left to fire.
B5.Warning.noTargetDv: Choose a target or enter a Defence Value.
B5.Warning.mixedArcs: The selected weapons fire into more than one arc — one offensive order covers a single arc.
B5.Warning.targetNotOwned: You do not own {name}; the damage was rolled but not applied.
B5.Telepathy.takeLethal: Take one lethal per die instead
B5.Telepathy.effortNeeded: Power {power} is above P{rating}: {dice}{die} nonlethal to reach it.
B5.Telepathy.withinRating: Within P{rating} — no mental effort needed.
B5.Telepathy.secondAbility: Already maintaining {count} — this check's DC rises by {bump}.
B5.Telepathy.knockedOut: The mental effort knocked the telepath out; the ability fails.
B5.Telepathy.nowMaintaining: Now being maintained — the action must be spent every round.
B5.Telepathy.failedCheckHint: A failed check does not always stop the ability: the telepath may simply fail to get what he was after, or cause side effects.
B5.Telepathy.saveHint: Rolls the Will save for every targeted token. A subject who saves is unaffected and costs the telepath 1 nonlethal.
B5.Telepathy.traitHint.accidentalScan: Success gives flashes equivalent to a brief surface scan, for as long as the contact lasts. The telepath is visibly distracted unless he makes a Bluff check at the same DC.
B5.Telepathy.traitHint.dangerSense: Success avoids being surprised. It reveals neither the source nor the direction, and never works against automated threats.
B5.Hint.traits: Traits run underneath the mind shield and cost no mental effort. Hold Shift on an accidental scan for the +4 when the subject feels extremely strong emotions.
B5.Hint.maintaining: Holding an ability costs its action every round, and each resisting subject gets a new Will save. Cancelling is a free action.
B5.Hint.abilityVariations: Variations and range upgrades are authored in the compendium source; an absolute variation replaces the DC, a relative one adds to it.
B5.Tooltip.abilityDc: Base Telepathy check DC for this ability
B5.Tooltip.gloves: Psi Corps gloves: −2 on Touch abilities and half the touch bonus
B5.Tooltip.suppressed: Sleeper drugs treat the telepath as P0 for ten days
B5.Tooltip.telepathyNonlethal: Nonlethal damage is the telepathic exhaustion track; at or above current hit points the telepath is unconscious
B5.Tooltip.useAbility: Roll the Telepathy check, paying any mental effort first
B5.Tooltip.multiSubject: May target several subjects: −2 per extra subject and +1 required Power
B5.Tooltip.accidentalScan: P1+: a Telepathy check on prolonged physical contact
B5.Tooltip.dangerSense: P7+: a Telepathy check to avoid being surprised by a sentient being
B5.Warning.abilityOutOfReach: {ability} needs Power {power}; mental effort reaches only {ceiling}.
B5.Warning.traitUnavailable: {trait} is not available at this P-Rating.
B5.Warning.noSaveTargets: Target the tokens that should resist first.
B5.Tooltip.rollShift: Click to roll; hold Shift for modifiers
B5.Hint.rollModifiers: Hold Shift on any roll to open the modifier prompt. Conditions already ticked on the sheet come pre-applied.
B5.Modifier.intoMelee: Firing into a melee with an ally
B5.Modifier.wrongDamageType: Nonlethal with a lethal weapon (or the reverse)
B5.Weapon.dryBurst: A burst needs three rounds; with fewer it misses automatically.
B5.Weapon.applyHint: Applies to every targeted token through its Damage Reduction; DR may take the hit to nothing.
B5.Weapon.noDvHint: No Defence Value given — damage was rolled but nothing was decided.
B5.Tooltip.attackWithWeapon: Roll this weapon's attack and damage
B5.Warning.noDamageTargets: Target the tokens that should take the damage first.
B5.Influence.burnOffer: Burning {points} would add +{boost} and make it.
B5.Influence.burnShort: Closing the gap needs {needed}; only {points} left to burn.
B5.Influence.burnHint: {faction} stands at {score}. Each point burned adds +{multiplier} to a failed check and is gone from the score for good.
B5.Influence.burnConfirm: Burn {points} of {faction}, permanently taking it from {from} to {to}? The check becomes {result} against DC {dc}.
B5.Influence.burnResult: {points} burned — the score drops from {from} to {to}, permanently.
B5.Influence.permanent: Burned Influence never comes back; nothing in this subsystem refreshes.
B5.Influence.scenarioReset: Repeat counters cleared on {count} Influence entries.
B5.Tooltip.influenceCheck: Roll an Influence check against a DC, with the burn offered on a failure
B5.Tooltip.newScenario: New scenario: clear the repeat counters
B5.Warning.influenceGone: That Influence entry no longer exists.
B5.Barrage.beamsIgnoreInterceptors: Nothing to intercept — beam weapons ignore interceptors.
B5.Barrage.interceptedHint: blank = roll the target's designated interceptors
B5.Barrage.interceptorsReady: {target} has interceptors designated: {detail}. Leave the field blank to roll them.
B5.Warning.noInterceptors: No working Interceptor mount and no Active Chaff to designate.
